scope: Both seven-qubit blocks of the IBM-067 figure. Ideal encoded ancillas, transversal CNOT, and physical measurement of the seven ancilla wires. X detection uses an encoded plus target. Z detection uses an encoded zero control and seven Hadamards before measurement. The encoder is the earlier verified IBM-060 circuit.
reference: For each data error the measured words form one Hamming-code coset of 16 words, each with probability 1/16. Compare all amplitudes before measurement and the complete normalized 14-qubit state after each word. The data block retains its faulty logical state and complex relative phase. The two readouts are separate circuits as drawn.
faults: Y (Z followed by X, up to overall phase)
